title: Direct summands of perfect complexes over a ring are perfect
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and let $K,L$ be objects of the derived category $D(A)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. If $K\oplus L$ is perfect [def-pc-perfect-ring-complex], then both $K$ and $L$ are perfect.
